contracts.scope: llm_agent and codex asset runtime command approvals
contracts.compound_shell_policy: split simple shell chains when Codex can parse them; treat advanced shell features as a single high-risk wrapper invocation
verification: codex execpolicy check for each promoted rule
contracts.promotion_gate: No prefix rule can be promoted without positive and negative examples that prove the prefix is not broader than the intended command family.
